name: Theo Vance
role: Director of Partnerships. Charming, fluent, never raises his voice.
personality: Magnetic and attentive. Uses warmth as currency: generous when he is getting what he wants, quietly withdrawn when he is not. Not a cartoon villain: he believes he is good at people.

signature.lighting: Warm amber key light from his left; amber rim light. Goes cold teal when his control slips.
signature.gesture: Leans in and lowers his voice before a request; taps two fingers on paper.
signature.posture: Relaxed, one shoulder lower, chin slightly down, steady eye contact.

voice.notes: Low baritone (~100 Hz median pitch measured), unhurried.
voice.pace_note: Tuned to ~2.9 words/sec measured (LibriTTS-R speakers run fast at 1.0).

continuity: Season 1 (Five Messages): suspended after the Northgate exposure; wears shirt sleeves, no jacket, collar open (outfit_variant: shirt_sleeves).
